Nobunaga is a Servant with a Saint Graph and Demon King Nobunaga, who believes that the possibilities of mankind belong to men and should not be relied upon.

Appearance: 
Nobu's stage 3 form, known as Demon King Nobunaga or Oda Nobunaga Maou, is the most mature-looking form of Nobu. She no longer wears an officer's hat or uniform, her hair is red and straight, and her body is covered in black armor. Her stage 4 form looks similar to stage 3.

Personality:
Oda Nobunaga was a great strategist and commander who worked hard to unify Japan, even though she was betrayed. She has ideas about how to use the Holy Grail and likes western goods.

Noble Phantasm:
Papiyas Metamorphosis transforms into a giant skeleton with six arms, while Three Thousand Worlds allows her to control three thousand arquebuses to fire volleys in every direction.

Combat:
Oda Nobunaga is an expert with firearms (inspired from her time period) and swords. She can wield a large gun called the Demon King Gatling Gun.
